messages:
maya (PM): quick decision thread — finalize Q2 MVP for Dedicated pools: opt-in escrow, per-tenant quota slabs, burst fallback, and autoscale defaults. Pilot with 2 customers. please react.

sam (Eng): keep MVP tight. escrow opt-in is ok if reclaim rules are simple and auditable. prefer pilot max_replicas=10 to control cost.

olivia (Sales): lighthouse wants a one-week launch escrow. opt-in would let me sign FinCo + smaller SaaS. need a visible meter in UI and separate billing line.

elena (Data): workload split: ~62% <30s, ~28% 1-10m, ~10% >1h. escrow helps the medium bursts. i can run a 48h replay for escrow vs no-escrow.

ryan (SRE): default OFF for escrow. if enabled, reclaim must be deterministic, emit audit events, and have a 15m eviction grace. no cross-region reclaim for MVP.

sam (Eng): proposed defaults: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=10, escrow_enabled=false, escrow_max_minutes=10080, scale_up_qps=600, up_cooldown_s=30, down_cooldown_s=300, fallback=route_to_cheaper_model.

maya (PM): decision asks: 1) escrow opt-in default OFF? 2) pilot max_replicas=10? 3) fallback default route-to-cheaper?

ryan (SRE): +1 conditional on runbook + audit schema + eviction webhooks.

sam (Eng): +1. will add billing export for escrow consumption timestamps.

elena (Data): ill produce harness results in 48h and include p95 latency, errors, reclaim frequency.

olivia (Sales): +1; will confirm pilot traffic tomorrow if escrow opt-in exists.

autoscale-bot: scheduled job: dedicated-escrow-loadtest-001 queued, ETA 48h.

maya (PM): action items: sam PR for API + escrow flag (EOW); elena harness (48h); ryan runbook + audit events (2d); olivia pilot commitment (tomorrow); maya gating doc (EOW). If no objections by EOD I will file roadmap ticket and lock MVP.

sam (Eng): +1

ryan (SRE): +1

elena (Data): +1

olivia (Sales): +1

maya (PM): thanks team — filing ticket. :rocket:
